profile.headline: Lead Developer at Comcast Cable
profile.summary:
I am working as a technical consultant at Valuelabs Inc with product engineering services group. 11+ years of experience in architecture, design and development of embedded products like TV Set-Top Box (STB) and mobile devices. 

Engaged in all phases of product development from ideation to conceptual design through end product realization.


Experience of Working in following Domains:

1) Set Top Box
2) Telecomm- handset middleware and application Development
3) Wimax
4) Microcontroller based software development

Currently handling responsibilities that varies from Architecture, Design till Development.


Highlights
=======
Sound working knowledge on Linux, C, C++ and design patterns.

Hands on experience in debugging on multiple hardware/software platforms including microcontrollers, handset, STBs.

Sounds knowledge of configuring and managing VOD back office.

Ability to learn and work with different teams across the software stack for issues analysis and fixing.

Strong communication, interpersonal & client interaction skills.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Scope of the project is to design, develop and port Comcast RDK stack on various OEM STB and TV hardware. This project involves various technologies to build a highly sophisticated STB/ TV product using RDK software stack.		
•	Technical lead: Architect, design, develop various feature RDK based STB and TV product to maximize software re-usability and less maintenance. 
•	Represent in cross functional team meetings.
•	mentoring and leading offshore team for developing software, track schedules, along with onsite development.
•	Design, Develop and Test middleware components on multiple hardware.
•	Architect, design and implement DIAL cast feature on various IP and MOCA based devices.  
•	Involve in Developing SSL communication for TRM module and Maintenance support.
•	Implementing new feature and maintenance of power manager module on various devices.
•	Design and implement and maintenance support for device settings feature to control Audio Video, front panel.
•	Worked on implementing MS12 audio feature on multiple hardware.
•	Worked on porting various feature and fixing multiple issues and enhancement of device setting, HDMI, CEC and DVR module reported by QA team.
•	Design and Implement Recording auto pad feature and integration support.

positions.title: Techinical Lead
positions.description: Managing offshore team for various tasks and providing guidance in analysis. Design and development of new feature and fixing existing issues in middleware and integration and porting on multiple hardware supporting different types of EPG. Configuring and maintaining VOD AXIOM/ Adrenalin back office.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: As a Scrum Master for IPClient and video Gateway project responsible for Engaging team in backlog grooming, sprint planning, retrospective and demos. Also responsible for design and development of VOD, Poster ART/Web Services feature and other enhancement.
